Job Purpose

The Client Manager is responsible to understand the business and most important be a bearer of relationship with Enterprise Customer, with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for the assigned Enterprise Customers. End to end operational excellence for the entire customer life cycle journey from opportunity to closure. The role of Client Manager is to focus on incremental product wise Revenue Market Share from those assigned accounts.
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities
Single & Most important bearer of Relationship with Enterprise Customer with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for all assigned Enterprise Customers.
Responsible for the incremental revenue growth on all product lines.
Farming - Protecting the Existing Revenue Stream from Competition & Downward Tariff Revision
Seeding New Products & Services - Cross Selling & Up selling - to enhance overall revenue
Business planning & Accurate Forecasting on Revenue, Order booking, Gross Addition, Gross Net, Net Addition, Churn, Billing, Collection & Bad debts.
Coordination with Cross Functional team to ensure sync in terms of tariff offering, other circle acquisitions, Order fulfilment, Issues Resolution & various other day to day activities
Monitor the service delivery and service assurance aspects are in line with agreed SLA / MSA
Facilitating Collections Team to ensure timely payments and reduction in bad debts
Manages detailed Account Dossier, Accont plans , Heat Map and update periodically.
Adhere and comply to all processes and systems of VIL & VIBS
Collaborative aproach within the team and organisation
Account Engagement and Account Mapping across multi levels /verticals
End to end operational responsibility leading to CXX
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience
Competencies
Experience in managing global and a track record of global accounts/ enterprise solution selling
Experience in complex change management and operating in a matrix, fast moving and technical environment.
Experience in working in multi-cultural environment ability to manage an international and distributed team.
Team player, strong influence and relationship management skills, customer centric.
Strong communication and decision making skills– ability to balance conflicting interests and ability to lead in a high-growth, high-uncertainty environments
Learning
To learn new products and services so as to be updated with the Customer needs and market trends
Apply the learning in own Customer scenario
Must have technical/ professional qualifications
Experience handling Strategic Accounts and C-level engagement
Education: MBA and Engineering background preferred
5+ years of experience
Should have preferably worked with Telecom, Technology Companies

We are looking for an experienced SAP CAR Consultant with expertise in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), CAR Planning, and UDF (Unified Demand Forecast) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.

Location - Mumbai/Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Gandhinagar

Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting

Mentor junior consultants and provide functional expertise during project execution.

Experience working on SAP S/4HANA PM implementations, migrations, or transformation projects.
Good understanding of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and maintenance management best practices.
Proven experience in maintenance planning, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, shutdown management, and asset lifecycle management.
Strong integration knowledge with SAP MM, QM, PP, PS, and FICO modules.
Experience in preparing functional specifications and coordinating with technical teams for developments and enhancements.
Exposure to Fiori applications and SAP S/4HANA innovations in Plant Maintenance.
Ability to independently interact with business stakeholders and translate business requirements into SAP solutions.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in client-facing consulting environments and global delivery models.

Prior experience in Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical, Automotive, Utilities, Chemicals, EPC, or Oil & Gas industries preferred.
Ability to work from Mumbai, Pune, or Bangalore and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice periods are preferred.

Job Title: Risk Senior Specialist
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
Location: Mumbai, India
Role Description
Market and Valuation Risk Management (MVRM) provides an independent view of market risks and valuation to Deutsche Bank s senior management. Market risk team manages Deutsche Bank s Market Risk position in an independent and neutral way.
You will be a part of the Market Risk Analysis and Control (MRAC) function within MVRM and will be responsible for the provision of all official market risk metrics and core analysis in support of risk management decision making for Rates asset class. The team operates a business/asset class and risk metric aligned organizational matrix supported by central functions. The team has a global presence with staff located in London, New York, Berlin, Singapore, Mumbai and Bangalore.
You will be exposed to risk management techniques viz. analysis/computation of VaR, SVaR, IRC, Backtesting, FRTB for a diverse range of derivative products. The team is also proficient in combining this risk knowledge with best in class automation and visualization skills including python/VBA/Tableau to provide value added analytical outputs to its stakeholders
You will be expected to be proficient in automation tools (python essentially) with sufficient knowledge of risk to enhance the output of the team.
Your key responsibilities
This role is within the Rates Asset class team. The primary responsibilities are:
Risk validation and ensure appropriate controls in place
Review and understand the historical simulation VaR, FRTB and Backtesting(outlier analysis), including staying abreast of the development of this metric and related drivers
Facilitating better risk analysis and automated reporting infrastructure to stakeholders using required programming tools(python/Tableau etc.) is a critical part of profile
Perform deep dive analysis into concentrations of risk or emerging items of interest, providing high quality and accurate information at a level for senior management consumption
Perform analytical analysis of our limit to generate proposals for limit changes and for new limits
Support the analysis and communication of business portfolio level topics to senior management and their committees
Your skills and experience
Experience in working with commodities especially Energy asset class is a must.
Experience in working with python and tableau is a must.
University degree in Economics, Mathematics or other quantitative subject.
5+ years experience in Market Risk within the Financial Market / Investment Banking industry (other relevant backgrounds e.g. Trading, Product Control, IPV will also be considered)
Proficiency in Python/VBA, Tableau, MS Office tools is essential for the role
Good understanding of other Market Risk measurement techniques e.g. VaR, RNIV, Economic Capital, IRC.
Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate technical and financial topics with global stakeholders
A reliable team player with the motivation to work in a dynamic, international and diverse environment
Able to multi-task and deliver under tight deadlines
A committed and motivated individual for self-development and growth
Hands on coding skills(Python specifically) and Tableau skills will be a significant plus
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Job Title: Senior Manager - SAP CO (Controlling) - SAP HANA
Location: [Mumbai ,pune,bangalore]
Department: IT / Finance /
Reports to: Director of ERP Solutions / Head of Finance Systems
Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager for SAP CO (Controlling) with expertise in SAP S/4 HANA. The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of the SAP Controlling module within our SAP S/4 HANA environment. This role requires both technical and functional expertise in SAP CO, along with strong leadership abilities to manage a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
SAP CO (Controlling) Implementation & Optimization:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Drive system enhancements and process optimizations in SAP CO in the context of SAP S/4 HANA, aligning them with business requirements.
Work closely with business users and other SAP functional teams (e.g., FI, MM, SD) to ensure seamless integration and data consistency across modules.

Project Management:
Manage end-to-end SAP CO module projects including planning, requirements gathering, design, testing, and go-live support.
Oversee SAP CO HANA transformation and migration projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and in budget.
Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:
Lead and develop a high-performing team of SAP CO professionals.
Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

System Maintenance & Support:
Ensure the continued smooth operation of the SAP CO module by providing technical support and troubleshooting.
Oversee regular system upgrades, patches, and performance tuning for SAP HANA.
Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Qualifications:
Experience:
8-12 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or senior management role.
Extensive experience with SAP S/4 HANA implementation, migration, or optimization in a Controlling context.
Proven track record in managing SAP CO projects, end-to-end implementations, or system enhancements.

Skills:
Strong expertise in SAP CO configuration (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Experience with SAP FICO integration (FI, MM, SD, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA features and capabilities related to CO.
Strong project management skills with a solid understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Additional Skills/Desirable:
Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.
Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

SUMMARY
Account Manager ETS Operations

Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead our Employee Transportation Services (ETS) operations across major Indian cities. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary liaison for key corporate clients, ensuring the delivery of exceptional transportation solutions. The ideal candidate will blend strategic account management with hands-on operational expertise to drive client satisfaction, foster long-term partnerships, and optimize service efficiency. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of employee mobility for leading organizations while managing a diverse portfolio of accounts.

Responsibilities
Cultivate and maintain comprehensive relationships with corporate clients, serving as their dedicated point of contact for all matters.
Address daily operational requests, manage service escalations, and resolve account-specific inquiries promptly and effectively.
Develop robust client partnerships to maximize satisfaction rates and ensure high levels of account retention.
Collaborate closely with internal operations teams to guarantee seamless service execution and strict adherence to agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Supervise end-to-end transportation logistics, including route optimization, staff rostering, vehicle allocation, and trip coordination.
Oversee the performance of fleet vendors, transport partners, and on-ground teams to uphold rigorous service quality standards.
Continuously monitor operational metrics to identify performance gaps and execute timely corrective measures.
Manage client performance reviews, generate detailed MIS reports, coordinate billing processes, and maintain accurate account documentation.
Proactively identify avenues for business expansion, account growth, and the enhancement of service delivery models.


Requirements
Possess a minimum of three years of relevant experience in Account Management, Client Relationship Management, Fleet Operations, or Transportation Services.
Demonstrate a proven track record of managing corporate clients and successfully handling high-value accounts.
Exhibit superior communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.
Show versatility in balancing client-facing duties with the practical execution of operational tasks.
Display strong analytical skills for problem-solving and effective management of complex escalations.
Maintain a solid understanding of fleet management principles, transportation logistics, and service delivery frameworks.
Be proficient in using MS Excel, creating MIS reports, and interpreting operational dashboards.
Possess excellent verbal and written communication capabilities.
Preferred Industry Background
Candidates with prior experience in the following sectors are highly encouraged to apply:
Food Delivery and Restaurant Account Management
Quick Commerce and E-commerce Key Account Management
IoT Solutions, including GPS Tracking and Dashcam Sales
Automobile Sales and Account Management
Real Estate Sales and Client Relationship Management
Fleet Management and Transportation Services

Manager/Senior - People Advisory Services
People Advisory Services shapes and delivers the part of business strategy that depends on people. As a PAS professional, you will have the opportunity to work with global clients to understand and address some of their largest and most complex people related challenges, and ultimately improve and drive sustainable business results. We focus on engagements that relate to performance, talent, systems, reward, mobility and analytics.
In joining PAS - a global network, youll also gain valuable experiences and a wealth of knowledge by working across capabilities, service offerings, sectors and geographies. So whenever you join, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
The opportunity: Manager/Scon - PAS Wkfa - National - CNS - PC - Workforce Advisory - Mumbai/Bangalore
As a member of the PAS team focused on HR and business performance, you will join a talented group of professionals that help support the design and implementation of HR operating models and organizational structures, improve HR process efficiency, manage people risks, support change efforts to help organizations to successfully transition to a future state, and advise organizations on a range of challenges that are associated with a merger, acquisition, divestiture and/or carve-out.
Your key capabilities
Talent Transformation
Leadership Development
Succesion Planning
Organizational Design
Performance Management and career mapping
HR Operating & Delivery Model
HR Process Efficiency & Policy
Organizational Change Management
Your key responsibilities
As a Manager/Senior Consultant, you will be a key resource on business transformation projects. In this role, you should be able to deliver quality client service, deliver insightful solutions and balance multiple priorities. You will also be expected to have excellent communication skills, integrate into and lead new teams, and rapidly establish relationships.
Demonstrate technical competence in our capabilities (Organizational Change Management, Organizational Design, HR Operating & Delivery Model, HR Process Efficiency & Policy and Transactions) and take a practical/business driven approach to solving complex client challenges
Contribute to generating profitable revenue through identifying follow-on engagement opportunities and developing lasting relationships with clients
Lead project work streams from planning through to implementation - managing project resources and budgets effectively
Be able to influence and persuade clients and stakeholders to gain support for any major change initiatives and/or decisions
Take a practical approach to solving issues and gaining client agreement
Encourage and facilitate collaboration amongst team members, and promote an inclusive working environment
Identify and effectively manage and mitigate any risks and issues
Contribute to business development and client pursuit activities by preparing proposals and delivering presentations for potential clients
Provide coaching and development opportunities for junior resources and peers, and act as a visible role model for our people
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent managerial, organizational, analytical and communication skills
Experience in Organizational Change Management, Organizational Design, HR Operating & Delivery Model, HR Process Efficiency & Policy and Transactions
To qualify for the role you must have
Post graduate degree or equivalent with a specialization in Human Resources (India or abroad) from a Tier 1 Institute.
3-5 years of experience for Senior Consultant in HR role (recruitment, organization structuring, manpower planning, compensation and benefits, learning and development, performance management etc.)
5-8 years of experience for Senior Consultant in HR role (recruitment, organization structuring, manpower planning, compensation and benefits, learning and development, performance management etc.)
Relevant professional experience, including for example previous work with a global management consultancy firm, niche consultancy or performed an in-house role in which you gained exposure to a large-scale project(s)
Ideally you\'ll also have
Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility.
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

Job Summary:
As a Talent Organization (TO) professional in the SC Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process.Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!


Roles Responsibilities:

Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Consultant in our TO practice, a typical day might include:
Collaborate with the client team to understand the business problem, identify the solution approach and work through the design, development, and delivery phases.
Conduct Training Needs Analysis to develop the training curriculum.
Develop high-quality and detailed content outlines as per the curriculum.
Design standards, guidelines, templates, and checklists for the proposed learning solution.
Collaborate with internal and client stakeholders to design and develop relevant and effective training deliverables.
Review training deliverables to ensure that the deliverable quality is as per the project quality parameters and industry standards.
Identify and share the risks with the Project Leads/Functional Manager to discuss possible solutions/mitigations/alternatives.
Coach instructional designers and content developers to prepare materials for instructor development workshops.
Provide clear and effective feedback to team with the intent to develop their instructional design skills.
Identify opportunities to implement new and innovative learning strategies into the solution.
Leverage proficiency in instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, content design, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Apply your strong knowledge in industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.

Qualification
Professional Technical Skills:
Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:6+years of proven experience in content development and instructional designing
Extensive experience in developing, reviewing and delivering different training modalities like Instructor-Led Trainings, Web-Based Trainings, application simulations, job aids, and quick reference guides
Experience in leading and coaching small teams independently

Prospect, educate, qualify, and generate interest for Sales Opportunities and lead conversions.
Ability to do product demonstrations to higher level authorities

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Should be proficient in English and Regional language (knowing the regional language of the job location

Should be comfortable working on weekends(Sat & Sun compulsory working), with a week off on Monday.
Effective presentation and negotiation skills.
Hands-on MS Office Excel, Word & PPT, etc.
Ability to handle CRM softwares
A valid drivers license(DL) with a two-wheeler/four-wheeler as this role requires you to be on the field.
Geographical knowledge of the job location is an added advantage.

Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes


Flexible working hours
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world


Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal

Uncapped variables based on performance

Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance

Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions for the outstanding performers

JOB TITLE
Manager - Interior Designer

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Tribeca is the largest branded luxury developer in India! Established in 2012, we have grown to become the largest developer of Trump-branded properties in the world (after the Trump Organization). Our current employee strength comprises more than 250+ associates across Mumbai, Pune, Delhi-NCR, Kolkata, and Bangalore, and we have a team of incredibly talented, hungry, bright, and passionate folks, including IIT, IIM, Wharton, and SPA toppers and industry stalwarts.

At Tribeca, we are focused on creating world-class products and customer experiences. We pioneered the concept of branded residences in India and are developing over 6 million square feet of branded residential projects in India. We are also proud to be developing the world's largest rooftop terrace.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Tribeca is seeking a Manager, Interior Design to lead interior design for luxury high-rise residential projects in Lower Parel, Mumbai. You will oversee design development, approvals, and delivery across sales galleries, show homes, common areas, and residential units, while driving material selection, vendor relationships, and procurement in line with the brands luxury positioning.

LOCATION: Lower Parel, Mumbai
EXPERIENCE: 10+ Years
REPORTING TO: Head Design - West

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Oversee and manage design development, approvals, and delivery across sales galleries, show homes, common areas, and residential units.
Ensure alignment with the brands luxury ethos and global design sensibilities.
Collaborate closely with internal teams (Project, Sales, Procurement) and external partners (consultants, architects, designers) to ensure smooth coordination and delivery.
Maintain strict adherence to timelines, quality standards, and budget expectations.
Conduct regular site visits to monitor design execution and resolve on-ground challenges.
Drive material selection, specifications, and sourcing decisions in line with the luxury positioning.
Provide creative input while ensuring feasibility, functionality, and execution efficiency.
Support sales teams with design narratives and customer walkthroughs.
Build and manage vendor relationships, including vendor empanelment, evaluation, and development, to maintain a reliable network of high-quality partners.
Source and specify luxury materials and products, including marble, fabrics, chandeliers, chairs, curtains, blinds, fittings, appliances, and wood polishing finishes, drawing on international designs and brands.
Apply a thorough understanding of layouts, materials, and detailing, from overall spatial planning to smaller finishing details.
Manage procurement and coordinate with distributors to ensure timely availability of approved materials and products.
Apply a functional working knowledge of AutoCAD to review and validate design drawings.
Stay well versed in emerging interior design trends, and translate them into project concepts, using platforms such as Pinterest for mood boards and inspiration.

QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE

B.Arch (Bachelor of Architecture) is mandatory.
10+ years of relevant experience in interior design, including experience leading or managing design teams.
Developer-side experience is a must.
Luxury residential high-rise project experience is essential.

KEY SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

Blend of creative vision and technical proficiency
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Keen eye for detail and aesthetics
Awareness of current design trends and styles
Effective problem-solving abilities
Proficiency in budgeting and cost estimation
Strong project management skills
Understanding of building codes and compliance requirements

Job

Summary :As a Digital Marketing Platform Consultant, you will be responsible for designing, building, and implementing strategies to enhance business performance using Customer Data Platforms and other digital marketing tools. Your typical day will involve working with clients to solve customer-facing challenges in sales, service, and marketing, and developing solutions to meet those requirements.

Roles & Responsibilities


Conduct assessment of client's current data management and Customer Data Platform (CDP) capabilities. Provide recommendations on optimizing the current stack and develop use cases to improve utilization .


Gather business requirements and strategize and build client's digital marketing data management program that delivers high-performance profiles for segmentation, personalization & activation across digital channels.


Identify different data sources, approaches to enrich customer profiles/segments in CDP and define use cases across multiple channels/destinations. Design data cleaning, transformation, and integration approach from various data sources into CDP.


Evaluate and recommend new ways of data management through CDP and how it connects into the broader marketing technology landscape (campaign management and insight generation).


Work as a BA or a functional consultant as part of CDP implementation. Plan, design, implement & integrate CDP solutions such as Adobe Experience Platform – RT CDP and work with partners to leverage various data management capabilities offered by these solutions.


Understand and convey the impact of regulations like CCPA, GDPR and client's own internal or industry regulation on data gathering and management. Guide towards privacy by design, consent management for customer profile activation across digital marketing channels.


Understand and design integrations (including API-based/file-based integrations) between tools/platforms of different vendors/ MarTech /AdTech components/data sources.


Stay abreast of MarTech landscape & engage ecosystem players/vendors to ensure best-in-class digital audience management capabilities for clients. Propose and conduct pilots as needed.


 Qualification 

Professional & Technical Skills


Must Have

Proficiency in Customer Data Platform, Adobe Experience Platform, Digital Audience Management.


Strong understanding of marketing processes, data management, data strategy, data integration, marketing & advertising technologies, and their integrations with other technologies.

Job Description
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

The Associate Agency Development Manager is responsible for driving business growth through the recruitment, development, and management of a team of insurance agents. This role involves identifying potential agents, conducting training sessions, and providing ongoing support to ensure agents meet their sales targets. The successful candidate will be focused on achieving branch sales goals, enhancing agent performance, and maintaining strong relationships with agents to foster a motivated sales environment. Key responsibilities include developing business plans, analyzing market trends, implementing sales strategies, and ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new agents to build a robust sales team.
- Design and implement training programs to enhance agents sales skills and product knowledge.
- Set performance targets for the team and monitor progress, providing feedback and support as needed.
- Foster growth and maintain motivation among agents through consistent communication and mentorship.
- Analyze sales data and market trends to develop effective sales strategies.
- Collaborate with management to align team goals with organizational objectives.
- Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements in the insurance sector.
- Organize performance assessments and identify areas for improvement for agents.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and team-building skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to analyze data and market trends effectively.
- Proficient in sales strategies and customer relationship management.
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Proven track record in sales and business development in the insurance sector.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho CRM).
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Data analysis tools for sales tracking and performance monitoring.
- Online training platforms for agent development.
- Communication tools (e.g., email, video conferencing software).

WE ARE HIRING: Field Sales Engineers (15 Openings Across India)

BT Print & PKG Solutions LLP is expanding! We are looking for dynamic, target-driven Field Sales Engineers to spearhead B2B sales for our advanced industrial coding, marking, and inspection portfolioincluding CIJ/TIJ Printers, Laser Marking Machines, and AI Inspection Systems.

If you thrive in industrial automation or high-velocity B2B sales and want to partner with leading manufacturers across the Food, Pharma, Beverage, Dairy, and Electronics sectors, we want to hear from you!

Locations: Kolkata | Delhi | Pune | Mumbai | Hyderabad | Chennai | Bangalore | Punjab

Openings: 15 Positions

Compensation: Competitive & Negotiable (Based on experience, location & industry standards)

What You’ll Do:
Drive Growth: Develop new business within your assigned territory and crush sales targets.

Pitch & Demonstrate: Conduct on-site client visits, technical presentations, and live product demos.

Nurture Accounts: Build strong, long-term relationships with existing clients to maximize retention.

Collaborate: Work alongside our service engineers to ensure smooth installation and after-sales support.

Represent & Report: Attend industry trade shows/exhibitions, track market intelligence, and share weekly/monthly pipeline reports with management.

What We’re Looking For:
Education: B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics preferred) OR MBA in Sales & Marketing.

Experience: 3–7 years in B2B field sales across Industrial Machinery, Automation, Packaging Solutions, or Banking/Financial Sales. (Prior experience in coding & marking equipment is a strong advantage!)

Skills: Solid technical aptitude for machinery, strong negotiation skills, and a self-starter attitude.

Mobility: Extensive regional travel is mandatory; owning a 2-wheeler or 4-wheeler is an added advantage.

We are a highly energetic team passionate about supporting business by providing high quality products and services which helps in reducing overheads and costs.

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge

Product Structure Management
BOM Management

CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills

PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
ITIL certification is preferred.
Required Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global and cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused approach with strong ownership mindset.
Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide production support when required.
Strong documentation and reporting skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter BMIDE knowledge.
Teamcenter Active Workspace exposure.
Aras administration/support experience.
Understanding of manufacturing and engineering business processes.
Exposure to deployment and release management activities.
Experience in performance tuning and application monitoring.

Experience collaborating with Data Engineering, Data Science, and MarTech teams.
Preferred
Experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).
Knowledge of React-based application deployments.
GCP Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer certification.

- PI/PO/CPI development knowledge for both part design as well as configuration.

Hands one experience on AIF (Application Interface Framework)
Basic ABAP knowledge and SAP BTP Knowledge
If SLD knowledge is there than it will be an added advantage.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a highly experienced Staff Engineer with deep expertise in Windows internals, Active Directory internals, and AD security. This is a single, combined role: you will build the Windows agent, model Active Directory at the protocol and database level, and reason about how attackers compromise a directory and how a defender recovers from it. The work spans granular change tracking, object recovery, forest-level backup, identity threat detection, and full forest recovery onto clean operating systems.
Responsibilities
Design and deliver AD protection features: granular change tracking, object- and attribute-level recovery, forest-aware backup, and full forest recovery.
Build and own the Windows agenta signed, serviceable, silently upgradeable component running on domain controllers.
Design identity threat detection: change-delta engines, rules for privileged-object and ACL abuse, and the findings pipeline into audit log and SIEM.
Own the safety of write and restore paths - idempotent steps, USN-rollback safety, pre-flight validation before any destructive action.
Engage across the security lifecycle: threat modeling, architecture review, attack-surface reduction, vulnerability remediation.
Work hands-on in code and test automation, including automated recovery drills and fidelity validation.
Lead projects, mentor engineers, and build Windows and AD depth across the team.
Education
B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Experience
10+ years in software design and development, with significant time on Windows-platform software.
5+ years with Active Directory internals - building software that reads, writes, replicates, backs up, or recovers directory data, not only administering it.
3+ years security-focused: identity security, detection engineering, security architecture, or product security.
Shipping agent or systems software onto customer-managed production infrastructure.
Windows Platform Agent Engineering
Windows internals: registry and hive structure, the SYSTEM hive and BootKey material, WMI, services, RPC.
Agent development in C++, C#, or Go; VSS writers and shadow copy APIs - writer sets, freeze/thaw, DiskShadow, orphaned shadows.
Windows security model: SIDs, tokens, privileges, ACLs and SDDL, impersonation, service accounts.
Serviceability and transport: code signing, MSI packaging, silent upgrade, mTLS and certificate handling, gRPC agent-to-cluster channels with resumable operations.
Debugging: WinDbg, ETW, performance counters, dump analysis; PowerShell modules, remoting, and hosting PowerShell from native code.
Active Directory Internals
Schema, object classes, naming contexts, linked-value replication; safe writes - modify, ModifyDN, object create.
LDAP at depth: filters, server controls, paged and persistent search, change notification; DirSync and USN cookies for incremental capture.
Tombstones, deleted-object lifetime, Recycle Bin; SID, SID history and GUID continuity semantics.
Group Policy internals (GPC/GPT, SYSVOL, DFSR/FRS, authoritative restore); AD-integrated DNS zones, forwarders, delegation.
Database and topology mechanics: ESE/JET, ntds.dit and logs, esentutl, FSMO, trusts, repadmin/dcdiag, USN rollback, DC promotion, IFM, DSRM, RODC.
Active Directory Security ITDR
Kerberos and NTLM internals: ticket flow, delegation, krbtgt and its role in forest compromise and recovery.
AD attack techniques and their detectable artifacts - DCSync, DCShadow, AdminSDHolder tampering, ACL abuse, privileged group manipulation, ticket forgery.
Detection engineering: deterministic rules with low false-positive rates, baseline-diff and attack-path reasoning; AD auditing and change attribution.
Cyber recovery of identity: clean-source and clean-OS principles, malware re-introduction risk in image-based restore, isolation during recovery.
SIEM integration (syslog, CEF, webhooks); threat modeling a component that runs privileged on a domain controller.
General
Distributed systems: durable state machines, idempotency, crash recovery and resume, long-running orchestration. Protocols: LDAP, Kerberos, DNS, SMB, TLS, gRPC, REST.
Test automation for infrastructure software: multi-domain forest labs, destructive recovery drills, upgrade and interop matrices.
Soft Skills
Excellent analytical skills under incomplete information - customer forests are never the lab forest.
Ability to lead initiatives, mentor, and explain directory-level failure modes to non-specialist audiences.
Sound judgement about risk. Recovery software gets one chance to be right, and knowing when not to proceed matters as much as knowing how.
Nice to Have
A commercial AD backup, recovery, or ITDR product, or having executed a real forest recovery.
AD tooling - DSInternals, BloodHound, PingCastle; hybrid identity with Entra ID and Entra Connect.
Windows kernel or filter driver work; EDR allowlisting; air-gapped or regulated environments.
Published security work, CVE credits, Red/Blue Team experience; OSCP, GCFA, or equivalent.
Location
This position is located in our office in Bangalore or Pune, India.

Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.

In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

About Us
Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by Avtar & Seramount. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery. 
WHY JOIN CAPCO?
You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.
MAKE AN IMPACT
Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.
#BEYOURSELFATWORK
Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.
CAREER ADVANCEMENT
With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.
DIVERSITY & INCLUSION
We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

Location - Pune/Bangalore

Experience - 5 to 10

Skills and Qualifications:

AI Engineer:

Key Responsiblities: 1. System Development: Designing and building AI models, such as neural networks, that learn from data and mimic human cognitive functions
2. Production Deployment: Transitioning research-level ML models into scalable, operational applications via APIs, microservices, or cloud platforms.
3. Data Handling & Training: Selecting, managing, and training models using large datasets, including natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision tasks.
4. Testing & Optimization: Evaluating accuracy, debugging, and improving AI performance to ensure systems run efficiently.
5. Collaboration: Working with data scientists and software engineers to align AI solutions with business objectives.

Required Skills and Qualifications:
1. Programming languages: Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or C++. How to use AI tooling to build up capability. Any UI/API automation framework.
2. ML Frameworks: Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or Scikit-learn. How to use MCP server.
3. Data & Cloud Tools: Proficiency in SQL, Big Data Technologies, and cloud platforms like AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Cloud
4. Technical Skills: Expertise in machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, and algorithm development.
5. Education: Typically requires a Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

Role: New Sales Development (B2B Corporate Sales)
Location: Mumbai / Bangalore / Gurgaon
Designation: Manager

Key Responsibilities:

1. Business Development: Prospect and approach potential clients for domestic services.
2. Sales Management: Achieve and exceed individual and team sales targets through proactive selling and account management.
3. Client Relationship: Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business.
4. Market Research: Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to develop strategic sales plans.
5. Pricing & Quotation: Prepare quotations, negotiate rates, and provide customized logistics solutions to clients.
6. Coordination: Work closely with operations, documentation, and customer service teams to ensure smooth express movement and excellent service delivery.
7. Team handling: Lead, manage, and mentor a team to ensure high performance, engagement, and achievement of business goals.

Person Specifications - Skillsets

1. A structured sales process for winning complex enterprise deals.
2. Excellent communication skills, an attitude to get things done,e and willingness to work in a high-growth start-up environment.
3. 5+ years of experience in field sales (corporate, retail, franchise, international sales).
4. A fair understanding of logistics operations will be an added advantage.
5. Local-based candidates with the relevant market knowledge will be preferred.
6. Ability to identify clients and clearly communicate the product offering to match their needs.
7. Proficiency in data analysis and ROI Management

Description:
Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecyclefrom concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.

Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking

Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Navisworks
MicroStation, ORD (Preferred )
ProjectWise / Forma
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Required Skills & Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Any Graduate.

About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-TMT-TAX-TAX - ITTS - Transfer Pricing - Bangalore
TMT
Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of MA strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future - building a better working world for all.
TAX - ITTS - Transfer Pricing
Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value.
We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Demonstrated expertise in developing and documenting transfer pricing policies for multinational enterprises across intercompany transactions. Strong working knowledge of arms length principles, OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, and applicable local and international tax regulations. Proficient in selecting and applying transfer pricing methodologies, including CUP, TNMM, cost-plus, and profit split approaches. Experienced in performing functional analysis and benchmarking studies to support defensible pricing positions. Skilled in preparing transfer pricing documentation, including master files, local files, and country-by-country reporting, in line with compliance requirements.
Qualifications
Bachelor of Commerce
Experience
0-1 years
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines

Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads

Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.

Graduation in any discipline

About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
