Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.

Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.

Job Title: React Native Mobile Developer

Required:
4+ years of experience in mobile application development, with at least 3+ years of hands-on React Native app development.
Required Skills & Experience:
Strong expertise in React Native, including developing UI components, navigation, and using state management libraries like Redux (Redux Toolkit) or MobX.
Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), including core concepts such as closures, hoisting, Promises, Arrow functions, and Rest/Spread operators.
Deep understanding of TypeScript, with hands-on experience in writing scalable and maintainable applications.
Solid experience in mobile app development, particularly in integrating RESTful APIs and handling asynchronous data flows.

Proficiency with Git or other version control systems for code collaboration.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, build processes, and deployment strategies for mobile apps.
Strong understanding of mobile app security, including data encryption, secure authentication, and safe data storage.
Experience with modern development tools such as React Navigation, push notifications, and unit testing frameworks.

Lead the development of React Native applications, ensuring best practices and high-quality code are followed.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build robust, scalable mobile solutions.
Act as a technical point of contact for the team, offering guidance on design, architecture, and implementation decisions.
Integrate APIs effectively and manage state using libraries like Redux (Redux Toolkit) or MobX.
Optimize mobile apps for performance, ensuring fast load times, responsiveness, and efficient resource usage across Android and iOS platforms.
Implement best practices in app security, including encryption, secure authentication, and safe data storage.
Actively contribute to hands-on coding, reviewing, and troubleshooting complex issues alongside the team.
Ensure continuous improvement in SDLC processes, fostering a culture of quality and efficiency within the development team.
Conduct thorough code reviews, ensuring adherence to SOLID principles, DRY principles, and design patterns to maintain a clean, maintainable codebase.
Troubleshoot and debug issues across Android and iOS environments using advanced debugging tools.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure timely delivery of features.

Advantage:
Experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK for iOS & Android, including Soup integration and data synchronization.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Consumer Goods Cloud.
Proficiency with Salesforce developer tools like Developer Console or Workbench.

Kafka / eventdriven streaming ingestion.

Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period preferred.

Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

We are hiring at multiple level for our Admin team in multiple locations - Mumbai, Indore and Pune

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Manager / Senior Manager Administration to oversee end-to-end administration, facilities management, infrastructure development, real estate, vendor management, and workplace operations across multiple locations. The role requires strong expertise in operational efficiency, property management, resource utilization, and administrative cost optimization.
Key Responsibilities:
Facilities & Infrastructure Management: Oversee the setup, maintenance, and management of corporate offices, branch offices, and project locations.
Real Estate & Property Management: Handle property scouting, site identification, property evaluation, lease coordination, rental negotiations, and ongoing property management.
Utilities & Building Systems: Manage generators, HVAC/AC systems, UPS, elevators, fire safety, security systems, pest control, and other essential utilities.
Asset & Premises Management: Ensure proper maintenance and optimal utilization of company-owned and leased properties, equipment, furniture, vehicles, and other assets.
Vendor Management & Procurement: Manage vendors and service providers, negotiate commercial terms, prepare bills of materials, process purchase orders, and coordinate delivery, installation, and commissioning.
Office Administration: Ensure smooth day-to-day operations, timely availability of office supplies, consumables, and other administrative requirements.
Repairs & Maintenance: Oversee repairs, maintenance, and replacement of office equipment, furniture, appliances, and infrastructure.
Utility & Cost Management: Monitor electricity, water, and other utility bills, ensure timely payments, and identify opportunities for administrative cost optimization.
Service Provider Coordination: Maintain effective relationships with vendors, contractors, landlords, and service providers to ensure quality and timely service delivery.
Compliance & Documentation: Maintain administrative records, vendor documents, property records, asset registers, and compliance documentation in line with company policies.

Required Skills & Competencies:
Strong knowledge of real estate, property scouting, property evaluation, lease negotiations, and property management, preferably from the same industry - Supply chain/Logistics
Excellent vendor management, commercial negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Familiarity with ERP systems, procurement workflows, database management, and administrative reporting.
Strong organizational, multitasking, time-management, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple locations, vendors, properties, and administrative priorities efficiently.
Focus on cost control, service quality, resource optimization, and operational excellence.
Educational Qualification: Any Graduate.
Experience Requirements:
5-15 years of relevant experience in administration, facilities management, infrastructure management, real estate, or corporate office operations.
Proven experience in vendor management, procurement, office setup, property scouting, property management, maintenance, and administrative cost optimization will be preferred.

Job Summary
Position Overview: Responsible for ensuring seamless and efficient service delivery operations across assigned regions under the NAMO program. The role focuses on escalation handling, PMS compliance, spare part management, AMC, Repaired and Service work order coordination, customer relationship management, and analytical reviews of recurring complaints to drive service quality and operational excellence.
Responsibilities
Calls and Escalation Management: Handle customer escalations efficiently by coordinating with regional, branch, and backend support teams. Ensure timely resolution and closure of critical issues in line with service SLAs and customer satisfaction goals. Proactively monitor open calls and follow up with stakeholders to prevent potential escalations. Analyse repeated complaint patterns, identify root causes, and share data-driven insights to reduce recurrence. Prepare escalation trend analysis reports for management review and continuous improvement.
Spare Parts Support: Facilitate timely availability and movement of spares across branches to minimize equipment downtime. Coordinate with the supply chain, vendors, and logistics partners for fast-track dispatches and replenishments. Ensure accurate documentation and tracking of part requirements under AMC and warranty cases. Monitor spare consumption and recommend strategies for inventory optimization.
PMS (Preventive Maintenance Schedule) Monitoring: Oversee PMS compliance across key customers (NAMO, Key NAMO) in assigned regions. Follow up with branch service teams to ensure 100% PMS completion and timely report submission. Highlight deviations and escalate gaps to management for closure before SLA or penalty impact. Drive improvements in PMS planning, documentation, and execution quality.
Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with key clients to ensure satisfaction and retention. Maintain regular communication with customers for updates, feedback, and issue resolutions. Participate in service review meetings to assess performance, turnaround time (TAT), and satisfaction levels. Ensure feedback and concerns-especially on recurring complaints-are tracked, analysed, and acted upon promptly.
Asset AMC Booking: Ensure Asset AMC booking, ensuring all assets are properly covered under valid service contracts. Coordinate with KAM Monthly meeting, branches, and commercial teams to ensure timely renewal and activation of AMCs. Maintain accurate records of AMC coverage, validity periods, and asset details in the system. Track AMC WO issuance to the CP's, coverage ratios, and pending renewals for proactive closure.
Internal Reporting and Analysis: Prepare and consolidate weekly/monthly regional performance reports for management review. Track and analyse key parameters such as escalations, PMS adherence, SDI (Service Delivery Index), and WO status. Perform analytical reviews of recurring complaints and technical issues to identify process or product gaps. Share actionable insights and recommendations to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
Work Order (WO) Issuance to Channel Partners: Issue Work Orders (WOs) to authorized channel partners in line with AMC, warranty, and service requirements. Ensure WOs are released promptly with clear scope, timelines, and customer details. Track WO progress, service completion, and ensure closure confirmation within defined SLAs. Monitor channel partner performance and provide feedback for service quality improvement. Coordinate with finance and service teams to ensure WO closure aligns with billing and documentation compliance.
Technical and Field Support: Provide technical guidance to field engineers for resolving major or recurring breakdowns. Support root cause analysis and define corrective/preventive actions to prevent repeat failures. Validate service quality post-resolution through customer feedback and review. Conduct technical knowledge-sharing sessions to enhance field team capability.

Description:
HEAD - BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
Investment Casting | Precision Engineering


Role Overview
Titan Consultancy is partnering with a distinguished precision engineering organization to identify a seasoned Business Development Leader capable of driving strategic global market expansion within the investment casting domain.
This leadership position requires a technically proficient and commercially astute professional who can architect and scale international business across critical industries including aerospace, defense, industrial valves, pumps, and precision engineering. The role demands comprehensive expertise in casting processes, global OEM engagement, and the strategic acumen to transform complex technical requirements into sustainable, long-term business partnerships.

Key Responsibilities
Market Development & Expansion
Identify and cultivate relationships with new international OEM customers across strategic segments including aerospace, defense, railways, industrial valves, and pump manufacturing
Architect and manage a robust business development pipeline across key global markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East
Key Account Management
Own and orchestrate relationships with global customers, including sophisticated commercial negotiations and long-term partnership agreements
Serve as the primary strategic interface between customers and internal cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution and delivery excellence
Drive superior customer satisfaction through consistent engagement, proactive communication, and exceptional delivery performance
Technical Sales & RFQ Management
Evaluate engineering drawings, technical specifications, and volume requirements to assess manufacturing feasibility within investment casting capabilities
Develop and present comprehensive techno-commercial proposals encompassing cost structures, delivery timelines, and quality assurance plans
Collaborate closely with engineering, tooling, and production teams to support RFQ responses, sampling processes, and customer approvals
Brand Representation & Market Intelligence
Represent the organization at international trade exhibitions, customer engagements, and strategic business forums
Develop compelling presentations, case studies, and capability documentation tailored for global client audiences
Gather and analyze market intelligence including competitor positioning, pricing dynamics, and evolving customer expectations
Forecasting & Business Planning
Drive export sales targets, revenue acceleration, and margin optimization through strategic account planning
Maintain accurate pipeline forecasts, opportunity tracking, and comprehensive business reports for executive leadership review
Contribute to strategic business planning, capacity utilization analysis, and long-term growth initiatives

Candidate Profile
Experience Requirements
5-7 years of progressive experience in business development or technical sales within:
-Investment casting/ Metal injection parts/Precision engineering / machined components/ -Valves, pumps, aerospace, or defense manufacturing ecosystems
Demonstrated track record in acquiring and successfully managing international OEM relationships
Proven experience navigating global markets including Europe, North America, or comparable international regions
Comprehensive exposure to export sales cycles, international documentation protocols, and compliance frameworks

Technical & Functional Skills
Deep understanding of investment casting processes, metallurgical properties, dimensional tolerances, understanding drawings and manufacturing workflows
Proficiency in interpreting complex engineering drawings, technical specifications, and manufacturing feasibility assessments
Expertise in cost modeling structures including tooling investments, yield optimization, alloy selection criteria, and machining economics
Working knowledge of quality management systems such as ISO 9001, IATF 16949, and aerospace quality standards
Comprehensive understanding of global logistics frameworks, INCOTERMS, and export-import documentation requirements

Behavioral & Leadership Competencies
Exceptional communication and presentation capabilities for engaging with C-suite executives and global stakeholders
Strong ownership mindset with demonstrated ability to operate effectively within senior leadership frameworks
Entrepreneurial approach with strategic focus on sustainable, long-term business development and market positioning
Proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional coordination and navigate complex, extended sales cycles

Work Expectations
Location: Karnataka (Mandya / Bengaluru region)
Role involves frequent international travel and client interactions across multiple time zones
Close collaboration with internal engineering, production, and quality assurance teams to ensure delivery excellence

This is a strategic leadership role with high organisational visibility and direct impact on global business growth trajectories. Ideal for accomplished professionals seeking to architect and scale international markets within a precision manufacturing environment.
AboutCompany:
About the Company
A precision engineering and manufacturing company specialising in Investment Casting (Lost Wax Casting) and the manufacture of high-quality steel components. The company caters to industries such as Automotive, Pumps & Valves, Defence, Electrical Switchgear and Food Processing.
The manufacturing facility is equipped to produce precision-engineered components using various grades of carbon steel, stainless steel and speciality steels.
Work Location: Tubinakere Industrial Area, Mandya, Karnataka 571402.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Manages kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Estimates daily production needs on a weekly basis and communicates production needs to kitchen personnel daily.
- Assists Executive Chef with all kitchen operations and preparation.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions.
- Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Performs all duties of kitchen managers and employees as necessary.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Operates and maintains all department equipment and reports malfunctions.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
Leading Kitchen Operations
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Recognizes success performance and produces desired results.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
Maintaining Culinary Goals
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Utilizes the Labor Management System to effectively schedule to business demands and for tracking of employee time and attendance.
- Trains employees in safety procedures.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Brings issues to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources as necessary.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Here is a professional Job Description for an Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo, suitable for recruitment portals, LinkedIn, and internal hiring.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo
Department: Operations
Designation: Assistant Restaurant Manager (ARM)
Industry: Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) / Food & Beverage
Reports To: Restaurant Manager / Area Operations Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: As per business requirement
About WOW! momo
WOW! momo is one of India’s leading homegrown QSR brands, known for its innovative food offerings, customer-centric approach, and fast-growing restaurant network. We are looking for energetic, customer-focused, and result-oriented professionals to join our restaurant operations team.
Job Purpose
To support the Restaurant Manager in managing day-to-day restaurant operations, ensuring excellent customer experience, maintaining food quality and safety standards, driving sales and profitability, and developing a motivated team that consistently delivers WOW! service.
Key Responsibilities
1. Restaurant Operations
Manage daily restaurant operations and ensure smooth functioning across all shifts.
Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational checklists, and company policies.
Monitor opening and closing activities, equipment functionality, cleanliness, and overall restaurant readiness.
Ensure timely order preparation, accurate billing, and efficient order delivery.
2. Sales & Business Performance
Drive daily sales and achieve assigned sales targets.
Monitor key performance indicators such as average order value, customer footfall, order accuracy, and sales growth.
Identify opportunities to improve upselling, cross-selling, and customer conversions.
Support cost control initiatives and improve restaurant profitability.
3. People Management & Development
Lead, coach, and motivate Team Members and Shift Managers.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective shift scheduling.
Drive employee engagement, attendance, discipline, and retention.
Train team members on product knowledge, customer service, food preparation, and operational standards.
Identify high-potential employees and support their career growth through on-the-job training and development.
4. Customer Experience
Ensure exceptional customer service and a positive dining experience.
Handle customer complaints and resolve service issues promptly.
Maintain service speed, product consistency, and order accuracy.
Build customer loyalty through friendly, efficient, and professional service.
5. Food Safety & Quality
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and food handling standards.
Monitor product quality, portion control, freshness, and adherence to recipes.
Ensure proper storage, stock rotation, and expiry-date monitoring.
Maintain a clean, safe, and hygienic restaurant environment.
6. Inventory & Cost Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely stock replenishment.
Minimize food wastage, pilferage, and operational losses.
Conduct stock counts and support inventory reconciliation.
Monitor consumption, food cost, packaging cost, and other controllable expenses.
7. Cash Management & Compliance
Ensure accurate cash handling, billing, POS operations, and end-of-day reconciliation.
Maintain operational records, registers, and reports as required.
Follow company policies and applicable statutory requirements.
Ensure proper handling of cash, inventory, and other company assets.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Graduate preferred; candidates with relevant qualifications and QSR experience may also be considered.
Experience: 2–4 years of experience in restaurant operations, preferably in QSR, food service, or retail operations.
Prior experience in team handling, shift management, customer service, and sales performance is preferred.
Required Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Customer-first attitude and problem-solving ability.
Sales orientation and business acumen.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.
Knowledge of inventory management, cash handling, and food safety.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays as per business requirements.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of restaurant sales targets.
Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
Food cost, wastage, and controllable expense management.
Employee attendance, retention, and manpower availability.
Food safety, hygiene, and audit compliance scores.
Order accuracy and service speed.
Team productivity, training completion, and internal promotions.
Career Growth
At WOW! momo, high-performing Assistant Restaurant Managers can develop their leadership capabilities and progress toward Restaurant Manager and higher operations leadership roles, based on performance and business requirements.
Why Join WOW! momo?
Opportunity to work with a growing Indian QSR brand.
Performance-driven work culture.
Hands-on operational and leadership development.
Career growth opportunities within the organization.
Join WOW! momo and be part of a team that delivers great food, great service, and a WOW! customer experience every day.
AboutCompany:
Wow! Momo's FMCG Business Overview
Wow! Momo, while primarily known for its QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) chain, is also making significant strides in the FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) sector. Here's a breakdown of the FMCG business:
Key Aspects:
Product Range:
Frozen Momos: This is a core offering, allowing customers to enjoy Wow! Momo's products at home.
Wow! Noodles: A recent addition, featuring a range of "Desi-Asian" flavored instant noodles.
Other Products: Includes items like Wow! Smiley, with plans to expand into categories like kulfi, Beverages called coco charge
Growth and Strategy:
Aggressive expansion in the FMCG segment is underway.
The company aims to establish the FMCG division as a substantial revenue contributor.
Focus on both online (e-commerce, especially quick commerce) and offline (general trade stores, modern trade outlets) distribution channels.
Financials:
The FMCG segment is currently smaller than the QSR business but exhibits rapid growth.
Ambitious revenue targets have been set for the FMCG division.
Overall: Wow! Momo is leveraging its brand to diversify into the FMCG sector, offering convenient food products to a broader consumer base.

Description:
Position: Cluster Human Resource

Eligibility Parameters:
3-4 years of experience in Human Resource generalist role.

Education Qualification
Minimum : MBA/ PGBDA (HR) (regular course)

Position Reports to : AHR /Zonal HR
Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Recruitment, Selection & Induction
Ties up with consultants to meet manpower requirements. Negotiate with them for least possible service fees.
Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal
Communicates to the staff the appraisal schedules & process to be followed which are sent be SO
Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines
Goes through appraisal forms to oversee the quality of the feedback & comments & evaluate objectivity
Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
Sends collated data to SO
Counsels employees if dissatisfaction arises post increments showing them the organization perspective & the way ahead

Description:
About Us: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role: Paytm is looking for an experienced sales professional & people manager to be a part of the QR & Sound Box vertical.
Expectations/ Requirements:
1.Growth of distribution and market share in the assigned area of operations.
2.Visibility & accountability through extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product .
3.Identify and recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4.Plan the market size, span and geographies for ASMs .
5.Devise best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
6.Monitor the quality parameters as suggested by the management.
7.Validate and conduct audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
8. People manage a large team of 5-10 TSMs & 200+ indirect employees.
Must Have: Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application the new learnt ideas and concepts.
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. Self-starters, who can take ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, will be an ideal fit. 8-12 years experience in sales - business development, B2C markets
2. Passionate about working in a fast growing firms and large team handling.
3. Articulate complex solutions to novice customers.
4. Good sales and negotiation skills. Experience in quota driven sales is a must.
5. Experience in payments and finance is a plus - though not mandatory
Why join us
A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager
Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Job Description: Senior GCP Lead
HGS is a global provider of technology, AI, and business services that helps organizations transform with confidence. At HGS, we combine technology, AI, and human expertise to deliver Intelligent Experiences that drive growth and transformation. Our strong foundation in CX enables us to create impactful solutions across industries. Through our Realized AI approach, we deliver practical innovation with measurable outcomes. Part of the multi-billion-dollar Hinduja Group, HGS takes a globally local approach with 17,000+ employees across 10 countries and 23 delivery centers.”

Position Summary:
As a Senior GCP Lead, you are the primary technical architect and strategic advisor for our most complex Google Cloud data engagements. You will own the high-level design of the data ecosystem, lead large-scale digital transformations, and ensure that technical solutions translate into tangible business ROI. This role requires a balance of architectural mastery, commercial awareness, and technical mentorship.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Architecture: Design end-to-end data ecosystems using Data Mesh or Medallion patterns.
Technical Authority: Hands on knowledge in BigQuery and Dataflow/Dataproc ETL design and automation using workflows or Airflow, Should be able to efficiently do RCA using logging and monitoring tools.
Performance & Cost Governance: Conduct deep-dive audits of BigQuery usage.
FinOps Strategy: Own the BigQuery Reservation strategy and optimize multi-million dollar cloud budgets.
Governance Frameworks: Architect organization-wide standards for Dataplex, security, and PII compliance.
Platform Security: Establish advanced security perimeters using VPC Service Controls and CMEK.
Team Leadership: Mentor Senior Engineers and define the technical standard for the entire practice. Participate in design discussions, code review, production deployment planning/cutover, data discovery sessions
Modernization Lead: Drive large-scale migrations from legacy on-prem systems to GCP Native solutions. Experience with third party data ingestion to GCP BQ/GCS

Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field;

Experience and Requirements:
Experience: 12+ years in Data Engineering, with 5+ years of specialized experience in Google Cloud.
Expertise: Deep, internal-level knowledge of BigQuery, BigLake, Dataflow, Dataproc, GCS, Data transfer services, Pubsub, cloud DLP.
AI/ML: Familiarity with operationalizing ML models via BigQuery ML and Vertex AI Pipelines (optional).
Ecosystem: Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and proficiency in Terraform/Cloudbuild/docker, CI/CD pipelines.
Certification: Professional Data Engineer (GCP) is mandatory.
Tools: Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines building for automated code deployments.
Why choose us?

5-9Years experience with solution scoping, development and delivery with Precisely (Winshuttle) Foundation, Evolve, Studio, Composer and SAP

Execute Winshuttle scripts ,Data extract, transform and load using Evolve
Automate SAP steps into Evolve workflow and Integrate with SAP and other systems
Data extraction for analytics and reporting purposes

Experience with leading a team across different process areas, geographies, work forces and technical expertise.

Should have rich experience in Data transformation Procedures, Post migration data validation procedures, Data retention, Data security procedures.

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities
Excellent written and oral communication as well as interpersonal skills
Experience working directly with various levels of client or internal team members including management
Highly motivated and able to perform in a remote work environment, independently as well as in team settings
Self-starter approach to work with an eagerness to consistently meet and exceed objectives

About Us: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the Role: Paytm is looking for an experienced sales professional & people manager to be a part of the QR & Sound Box vertical.
Expectations/ Requirements:
1.Growth of distribution and market share in the assigned area of operations.
2.Visibility & accountability through extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product .
3.Identify and recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4.Plan the market size, span and geographies for ASMs .
5.Devise best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
6.Monitor the quality parameters as suggested by the management.
7.Validate and conduct audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
8. People manage a large team of 5-10 TSMs & 200+ indirect employees.
Must Have: Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application the new learnt ideas and concepts.
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. Self-starters, who can take ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, will be an ideal fit. 8-12 years experience in sales - business development, B2C markets
2. Passionate about working in a fast growing firms and large team handling.
3. Articulate complex solutions to novice customers.
4. Good sales and negotiation skills. Experience in quota driven sales is a must.
5. Experience in payments and finance is a plus - though not mandatory
Why join us
A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager
Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Key missions of the position:
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Service Engineer to join our team, specializing in the Troubleshooting of field complaint and perform installation, commissioning and maintenance of Wabtec systems. The candidate will require to have a strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and Pneumatic circuit diagrams, electronic components, and their working principles. This role requires hands-on experience in trou
bleshooting, repairing of Electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems.
Roles and responsibility are as below:
Production Support: Assist in the Installation, commissioning, Testing of Wabtec system/Product in the rolling stock
Field Complaint Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve the field complaints related to Wabtec systems, providing timely resolution and closure of the complaints. Such requirement relates to troubleshooting the Mechanical, electrical, electronics, pneumatic or maintenance related issues and relacing the defective part to close the complaint within the contractual timelines.
Installation and Commissioning: Support the installation and commissioning of the Wabtec product and performing the required testing. Enabling customer to perform the task in a right manner if needed.
Retrofit, Maintenance and Repairs: Perform retrofit, regular maintenance and emergency repairs on Wabtec products inline with procedure and site requirement.
Reporting and Documentation: Report and record the field interventions performed by himself and associated team. The service engineer would require making a report of the issue and also get the Joint notes or associated document as needed by customer contract. Daily, weekly and Monthly reports to be submitted to manager.
NCR and Failed Part Management: Maintain accountability for Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), maintain consumed spares/Failed part and site spares data. Organizing the dispatch of the defective parts from site to plant in co-ordination with plant team.
Customer Interaction: Communicate effectively with clients to understand their issues and provide clear explanations of the work performed. Follow up the closure of Nonconformity reports and work orders issued.
Travel: Willingness to travel across India to various sites as needed for warranty, installation & Commissioning, retrofit and maintenance service for the customer order.
Safety, Quality, and Compliance: Ensure all work is performed in accordance with our organizations strict safety, quality, and compliance standards.
Education/Training
Degree or Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical & electronics.
Professional Experience:
How many years of professional experience in a specific professional area are required for the position?
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role (Field service) preferably in the transportation railways or Lifts and escalator with good troubleshooting skills
Key Competences (Transversal/Professional)
Reading and interpreting circuit diagrams : Intermediate
Knowledge on software installation : Novice
Troubleshooting & repair:Advanced
problem-solving abilities: Advanced
Microsoft Office:Intermediate
Communication: English speaking and writing:Intermediate
Languages:
English and Hindi & Any other regional language (is an added advantage)
Other Specifications:
Position will be initially in Eastern region, subsequently transferrable anywhere in the country
Ability to learn quickly. Agility to adapt to new environment/ business strategies
Collaborate with multiple departments
Passionate to lead and take initiatives
Good attitude and interpersonal relationship

Description:
WE ARE HIRING | JUNIOR ACCOUNTANT & MIS EXECUTIVE
Company: Mecon Chemical
Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh
Mecon Chemical is looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and result-oriented professional to
join our Finance & Accounts team as a Junior Accountant & MIS Executive.
The ideal candidate should possess strong proficiency in Advanced Microsoft Excel, practical
working knowledge of Tally Prime, and the ability to extract, process, analyze, and present
financial and business data through structured MIS reports.
The primary focus of this position will be MIS reporting and data analysis, with Tally Prime
serving as the key source for extracting accounting and transactional data.
1. Position Details
Job Title: Junior Accountant & MIS Executive
Department: Finance & Accounts
Experience: Minimum 2 Years
Qualification: Any Graduate
Job Type: Full-Time
Vacancies: 2
Salary: Up to 25,000 per month
Job Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh
2. Job Overview
We are seeking a skilled and analytical Junior Accountant & MIS Executive who can
independently manage MIS reporting activities and financial data analysis.
The selected candidate will primarily be responsible for extracting financial and transactional
data from Tally Prime, processing and analyzing the information using Advanced Excel, and
preparing daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management review.
The role requires strong expertise in Excel-based reporting, data management, report
automation, and financial data interpretation, along with practical knowledge of Tally Prime to
ensure accurate data extraction and reporting.
3. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. MIS Reporting & Data Analysis
1. Extract financial and transactional data from Tally Prime for MIS preparation and
management reporting.
2. Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports as per business
requirements.
3. Develop and maintain structured Excel-based reports, dashboards, and performance
trackers.
4. Prepare sales, purchase, revenue, expense, payment, collection, and outstanding
reports.
5. Consolidate and analyze data extracted from Tally Prime and other relevant business
sources.
6. Prepare comparative and analytical reports to identify business trends, variations, and
performance gaps.
7. Monitor sales transactions, customer outstanding balances, vendor payments, and
collection performance.
8. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely submission of all MIS reports.
9. Identify discrepancies in reported data and coordinate with relevant departments for
verification and resolution.
10. Generate customized MIS reports and provide relevant data insights to management as
required.
B. Tally Prime Data Extraction & Reporting
1. Extract relevant accounting and transactional data from Tally Prime for reporting
purposes.
2. Generate and export sales registers, purchase registers, ledger reports, outstanding
reports, and other accounting reports.
3. Retrieve customer-wise, vendor-wise, and transaction-wise data for MIS preparation.
4. Verify extracted data for accuracy and completeness before incorporating it into MIS
reports.
5. Understand Tally Prime reports and accounting data structures to ensure accurate
reporting.

6. Coordinate with the accounts team to obtain and validate the required financial
information.
C. Advanced Excel & MIS Management
1. Develop and maintain Excel-based MIS templates and reporting formats.
2. Use advanced Excel functions to process, consolidate, and analyze large volumes of data.
3. Create automated reports and management dashboards to improve reporting efficiency.
4. Maintain master data, reporting databases, and historical MIS records.
5. Streamline reporting processes and improve the accuracy and efficiency of data
management.
6. Present business information in a structured and easy-to-understand format for
management review.
4. Mandatory Technical Skills
A. Tally Prime – Practical Working Knowledge
Ability to independently navigate and work with Tally Prime.
Knowledge of generating and exporting sales, purchase, ledger, and outstanding reports.
Understanding of customer-wise and vendor-wise accounting data.
Ability to extract transaction-level and summary-level information.
Familiarity with accounting reports and financial data structures.
B. Advanced Microsoft Excel – Strong Proficiency
VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP.
Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts.
SUMIF / SUMIFS and COUNTIF / COUNTIFS.
IF, IFERROR, and logical functions.
INDEX and MATCH.
Data sorting, filtering, conditional formatting, and data validation.
Data consolidation and reconciliation.
Preparation of automated MIS reports and interactive dashboards.

Ability to handle and analyze large datasets efficiently.
C. MIS Reporting & Analytical Skills
Experience in preparing daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
Knowledge of sales, purchase, expense, collection, and outstanding analysis.
Ability to perform data validation, reconciliation, and discrepancy identification.
Preparation of management reports and performance dashboards.
Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
5. Candidate Profile & Eligibility Criteria
B.Com / M.Com / BBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification.
Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in MIS Reporting, MIS
Operations, Accounts MIS, or Financial Data Analysis.
Practical working knowledge of Tally Prime is mandatory.
Strong proficiency in Advanced Microsoft Excel is mandatory.
Previous experience in extracting and analyzing accounting data from Tally Prime.
Ability to independently prepare, maintain, and manage MIS reports.
Good understanding of sales, purchases, receivables, payables, and financial
transactions.
Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple reporting requirements and meet deadlines.
6. Preferred Industry Experience
Candidates with previous experience in manufacturing, trading, chemical, or industrial
organizations will be preferred.
Exposure to sales MIS, purchase MIS, inventory reporting, customer outstanding analysis,
vendor reporting, and management dashboards will be an added advantage.
7. Key Role Expectations

The selected candidate will be primarily responsible for managing the complete MIS reporting
cycle, from extracting relevant data from Tally Prime to processing, analyzing, and presenting
information through Advanced Excel reports.
The individual should be capable of independently handling reporting requirements,
maintaining data accuracy, identifying business trends, and providing timely and reliable MIS
information to management.
Strong Excel proficiency, practical Tally Prime knowledge, analytical capabilities, and a
structured approach to reporting will be essential for success in this position.
8. Compensation
Monthly Salary: Up to 25,000, depending on relevant experience and skill set.
Full-time employment.
Opportunity to work closely with management and contribute to business reporting and
analysis.
9. How to Apply
Interested candidates can share their updated CV through LinkedIn or WhatsApp.

Description:
WE ARE HIRING | SENIOR ACCOUNTANT

Company: Mecon Chemical
Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh

Mecon Chemical is looking for a detail-oriented and motivated Senior Accountant to join our
Finance & Accounts team.

If you have a strong understanding of accounting principles and practical experience in
accounting operations, we would love to hear from you!
Position Details:
- Job Title: Senior Accountant
- Department: Finance & Accounts
- Experience: 6 to 8 Years
- Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / BBA (Finance)
- Job Type: Full-Time
- Vacancies: 2
- Salary: 35k to 45k
- Location: Indore
Job Summary
We are looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated Senior Accountant to join our
finance and accounting team. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining
accurate financial records, supporting accounting operations, preparing financial reports, and
ensuring timely completion of accounting activities.
This role is ideal for someone who has a strong foundation in accounting principles, excellent
attention to detail, and a desire to develop their career in a fast-paced professional

environment. You will work closely with senior accountants and cross-functional teams to
ensure financial accuracy, compliance, and efficient financial processes.

Key Responsibilities
Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records, including general ledger, accounts
payable, accounts receivable, and journal entries.
Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, management
reports, and financial analysis.
Perform regular bank, credit card, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general
ledger reconciliations and investigate discrepancies promptly.
Process and verify invoices, payments, receipts, expense reports, and other financial
transactions in accordance with company policies.
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities, including accruals,
adjustments, reconciliations, and account reviews.
Assist with tax compliance, statutory filings, audits, and preparation of supporting
schedules and documentation.
Monitor outstanding receivables and payables and assist in maintaining healthy cash
flow and working capital.
Assist with budget monitoring, expense tracking, variance analysis, and financial
forecasting.
Review financial transactions for accuracy, completeness, appropriate authorization, and
compliance with accounting policies.
Maintain well-organized and audit-ready financial documentation, records, and
supporting schedules.
Identify accounting discrepancies, unusual transactions, and process gaps, and work
with relevant teams to resolve them efficiently.

Support senior accountants and management with financial analysis, ad-hoc reports,
and accounting projects.
Contribute to improving accounting processes, internal controls, reporting accuracy, and
overall efficiency.
Ensure all accounting activities are performed in accordance with applicable accounting
standards, tax regulations, internal controls, and company procedures.
Maintain confidentiality and integrity of sensitive financial and business information.

Key Skills & Competencies
Strong understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping practices.
Excellent numerical, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Good knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and general
ledger accounting.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting/Tally prime software.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to meet deadlines.
Ability to identify discrepancies and take initiative to resolve issues.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with senior accountants
and other departments.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, confidentiality, and professional integrity.
Willingness to learn, adapt, and take on increasing responsibility.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
Knowledge of accounting standards and basic tax/compliance requirements.
Experience with accounting software, Tally prime systems, or financial management tools is an

advantage

Preferred: Candidates having experience in manufacturing or chemical industries will be given
preference.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV through LinkedIn or send their resume to the
company's recruitment team.

Job Overview
We are looking for a proactive, commercially driven, and result-oriented Business Development
Executive to strengthen our B2B sales and business development operations.
The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities,
developing strategic client relationships, and driving business growth through direct
engagement with factories, manufacturing units, and industrial establishments.
The role requires regular interaction with business owners, directors, purchase managers, and
other key decision-makers to understand their requirements, present relevant business
solutions, negotiate commercial terms, and convert prospective opportunities into successful
business partnerships.
Candidates with proven B2B sales or business development experience across any industry or
sector are encouraged to apply.
2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

1. Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities across factories,
manufacturing units, and industrial establishments.
2. Establish and maintain professional relationships with factory owners, directors,
purchase managers, and other key decision-makers.

3. Conduct regular client visits and business meetings to understand customer
requirements and identify potential business opportunities.
4. Present company offerings, business proposals, quotations, and commercial
solutions to prospective clients.
5. Prepare and deliver structured business presentations aligned with client
requirements.
6. Lead commercial discussions, negotiate pricing and business terms, and drive
successful deal closures.
7. Develop and maintain long-term client relationships to strengthen customer
engagement and generate repeat business.
8. Manage prospective client pipelines through systematic follow-ups, lead
nurturing, and opportunity conversion.
9. Coordinate with internal departments for proposal development, pricing
approvals, quotations, and order processing.
10. Maintain accurate documentation of client interactions, business meetings, sales
activities, and follow-up schedules.
3. Candidate Profile & Eligibility Criteria

Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in B2B Sales, Business Development,
Industrial Sales, or Field Sales.
Candidates from any industry or sector with demonstrable B2B sales experience
are eligible.
Preference will be given to candidates based in Indore.
Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period will be preferred.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong business development, client acquisition, negotiation, and deal-closing
capabilities.
Ability to independently manage client meetings and engage confidently with
senior-level stakeholders.
Proficiency in preparing and delivering professional business presentations.
Working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Strong interpersonal, relationship management, and client-handling skills.
Willingness to undertake business travel approximately 10 days per month.

4. Compensation & Benefits

Fixed Monthly Salary: 30,000 40,000, depending on relevant experience,
competencies, and suitability for the role.
Travel Allowance (TA): As per company policy.
Daily Allowance (DA): Applicable for official business travel.
Health Insurance: Coverage as per company policy.
Travel Reimbursement: Approved official travel expenses will be reimbursed as
per company policy.
5. Key Role Expectations
The selected candidate will be expected to independently manage the complete business
development cycle, from identifying prospective industrial clients to converting business
opportunities into confirmed deals.
The individual should demonstrate strong commercial awareness, professional communication,
effective negotiation skills, and the ability to build meaningful business relationships with key
decision-makers.
A proactive approach towards client acquisition, market development, and business expansion
will be essential for success in this role.
